title: Organ Giants | The Influence of J.S. Bach Recital 3 | Simon Johnson
description:
This recital is part of a two year long series to celebrate 150 years of the Willis heart of the Grand Organ of St Paul's. Join Simon Johnson as he continues his 10 recitals exploring the influence of J.S. Bach.

For details of what is being played today, with notes about each piece, please click here: https://www.stpauls.co.uk/worship-music/music/concerts-and-events/sunday-organ-recitals

St Paul's Cathedral has reopened for worship and prayer, though recitals are being live-streamed only at present.

Recitals form an integral part of the weekly liturgical and musical offering at St Paul’s, and we are pleased to be able to share this offering with you.
